task_completion.description: Agent logs into the SEB Server using the provided credentials.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The SEB Server dashboard or login page showing 'super-admin' logged in or the transition from the login screen to the main interface.

task_completion.description: Agent navigates to the section for creating or managing exam configurations.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The browser shows the 'Exam configurations' menu item selected or the list of existing configurations.

task_completion.description: Agent enters the specific name and description for the configuration.
task_completion.visual_evidence: Input fields showing 'CS101 Final Exam Configuration' in the name field and 'Secure configuration for CS101 Introduction to Computer Science final examination' in the description field.

task_completion.description: Agent ensures 'Allow browser window reload' is disabled.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A checkbox or toggle for 'Allow browser window reload' (often under Browser settings) is unchecked or set to 'No'.

task_completion.description: Agent ensures 'Allow Virtual Machine Detection' is enabled.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A checkbox or toggle for 'Allow Virtual Machine Detection' (often under Security settings) is checked or set to 'Yes'.

task_completion.description: Agent saves the new configuration and it appears in the list.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A success message (e.g., 'Configuration saved') or the 'CS101 Final Exam Configuration' appearing in the list of configurations.

integrity.description: The agent used the web interface rather than direct database manipulation via terminal.
integrity.visual_evidence: Screenshots show mouse movements, clicks, and typing within the browser window at http://localhost:8080, not just a terminal window.

integrity.description: The agent did not run a script to automate the API calls directly.
integrity.visual_evidence: The agent is seen interacting with the UI elements (buttons, text fields) of the SEB Server web application.

integrity.description: The agent typed or pasted the specific strings into the UI fields.
integrity.visual_evidence: The text 'CS101 Final Exam Configuration' is visible within the SEB Server's form fields before submission.

privileged_info_for_vlm: The SEB Server is located at http://localhost:8080. The specific configuration name 'CS101 Final Exam Configuration' must be created. The 'Allow browser window reload' setting must be OFF, and 'Allow Virtual Machine Detection' must be ON. Verification is successful if these specific settings are visible in the SEB Server UI during or after creation.
